subject: general
question: The official name (in English) of Bangladesh is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**People's Republic of Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bangladesh** is a country in South Asia that is officially known as the **People's Republic of Bangladesh**.
 
• It is the** world's seventh most populous country**, with almost 163 million people living in an area of either** 148,460 square kilometres or 147,570 square kilometres**, making it one of the **world's most densely inhabited countries**.
 
• Bangladesh shares land boundaries with India to the west, north, and east, as well as Myanmar to the southeast, and the Bay of Bengal to the south.
 
• When Bengali East Pakistan seceded from the union with (West) Pakistan in 1971, the People's Republic of Bangladesh was formed. 
 
• When British India was partitioned along religious, linguistic, and cultural lines in August 1947, the boundaries of contemporary Bangladesh were created.
 
• The western portion of the region became West Bengal, which is today a state in eastern India, and the eastern section became East Pakistan, which was part of the newly founded Pakistan Dominion.
